Though in this case, I mean the verb "suit"...
as in "to be appropriate, fitting, or to look good on someone."
Haaah!

Not at all!
I look forward to seeing you at the Academy next time.

First, let's hear your vision. Trainer,
what kind of style do you picture when you think of "trustworthy fashion"?

After thinking it over and agonizing, I thought... if I dressed more properly,
maybe what I say would carry more weight... Clinging to that hope, I came looking for clothes, but—

I'm North Flight.
An Umamusume from Tracen Academy, Trainer♪

Of course, this is merely one suggestion.
Since the theme was "trustworthy," I put it together with that direction in mind.

Take that cardigan, for instance. If you want to steer its patchwork vintage feel
toward chic rather than cute... let's tighten the look with an inner layer.

A businesslike relationship meant to accomplish what needs to be done...
Isn't that, in its own right, a form of trust as well?

...Mm-hmm, understood! I want to give you a full consultation,
so why don't we change locations for a moment?

I see. In that case, this will be simple♪
For your goal, Trainer—it has to be a "suit"!

Oh, you're right. You look like a real "Trainer."
...Ah, hey, mind if I ask you about a part of the assignment I don't get?

Have confidence in yourself.
You are a wonderful Trainer♪

That pin! It's your Trainer pin, isn't it?
A design that feels simple yet honest... It's just wonderful.

If she can just tell me the little things, I can pick up on even the feelings she can't put into words.
So that I can help uncover the true brilliance inside her—

...It might not be my place to say this,
but taking on that girl... would probably be too much for you.

Figuring that "looking proper" probably meant more expensive clothes,
I mentioned that I had brought along a fairly generous budget.

I felt a little pathetic relying on someone younger than me, but this fashionable girl
looked like a shining savior to someone lost in a labyrinth of style—

Oh, forgive me for jumping in like that!
It's just, I absolutely adore everything about fashion.

Fashion is a way to make you—the brilliant canvas of who you are—
look all the more wonderful. Let's explore every angle together♪

If we go with charcoal gray, we can preserve your naturally gentle aura,
Trainer. And if we pick accessories matching the color from your cardigan...――

You can!
—With the power of fashion♪

"I want to expand their potential."
Your mindset genuinely moved me.

As a rookie Trainer, I spent my days rushing about scouting Umamusume...
Yet somehow lacking an air of reliability, none of them gave me the time of day.

You already have such wonderful "raw material."
So long as we find the ideal coordination to match it—

There's a philosophy in fashion about adding and subtracting.
Depending on the combination, you can dramatically change the impression you leave.

Um...
Could you perhaps be having some trouble?

Saying that made a question cross my mind. With talent like hers,
why didn't she have a Trainer? Nor did anyone else seem to approach her.
Fashion really is difficult.

—Wait, Trainer! You seem...
a bit different than usual today? Super stylish!

Oh, does that give you pause?
Business styles are totally on the table, you know?

Just by changing my clothes, an Umamusume greeted me warmly.
On top of that, I realized... I was speaking far more confidently than usual.

You will surely shine.
I bet you'll carry an aura that makes people naturally want to place their trust in you♪

First and foremost, fashion is all about freedom.
However, there are coordinate styles that one might never think of alone.

Yes, yes, wonderful! Versatile variety, and a design that suits anyone.
Especially in business scenarios, it will project a proper sense of reliability.

...I see, so you have a different vision in mind. Then let's think broader...
What kind of trusting relationship do you wish to build?

I understood at a single glance. Her incredible speed...
Its sheer brilliance, its boundless, dazzling potential...!

What immediately came to mind was the image of office workers seen around train stations.
Dressed in sharp suits, they carried a serious, competent presence.

If you're having trouble with fashion, Trainer,
I would be more than happy to help you out.

Fufu.
Yes, if you're okay with it, Trainer, I'd love to!

North Flight... her body... has been frail since she was born.
Even with all that talent, without a body that can endure racing... it's hopeless.

Hey there, working hard, are we... Wait.
Were you... watching North Flight?

Wanting to thank her, I went looking for North Flight—
and found her standing at the starting line of the 2,000-meter course.
—A shockwave of speed tore right across my eyes.

North Flight slowed down before ever reaching her top speed.
It looked like she had so much more to give, and yet...

—Oh, how wonderful♪ This coordinate brings out both
your intelligence and your mature charm, Trainer!

Now then...
Let's begin "Fu-chan's Fashion Advice"♪

Keeping mix-and-match versatility in mind, why don't we build a few
outfits based on the pieces you're wearing today, Trainer?

And so... by the time we parted ways, we had put together five "wonderful"
coordinated outfits—for less than half of my planned budget.

—I see. So you're looking for an outfit that will inspire
trust from the Umamusume, is that right?

The next day... wearing the outfit North Flight chose for me, I headed to the academy.
Feeling "wonderful" about how I looked, my back naturally straightened up.
